Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emile Bosman wrote:
>
> If i have a Succuvus club in play and I've played a Derange on a
> vampire can I then.
>
> Make a deal in which Minion A(the minion with the Derange on it) loose
> the Derange and Minion B (Being a Malkavian or a !Malkavian) receive
> on or does this still constitute as put on thus being played on.

You cannot make a trade whereby "Minion A" loses the Derange at all.

You can trade control of the Derange, but changing control of that
card won't cause it to move from its perch on Minion A.

Messages.Body:

> Also, is there anything stopping you from, say, Malk Time Auctioning a
> stolen vampire (Using the Derange/Malkavian Dementia combo) - assuming

> you can get a second master phase [action]?

No.

> Presumably, unless the original
> controller of the auctioned vampire wins the bid, that vamp NEVER goes
> back to him (even when the Malk Dementia would've ended)... Is this
> right?

Yes. Changing permanent control of a card erases any lingering
temporary control effects.
